attribution: Teads / Benjamin Davy, AWS EC2 Carbon Footprint Dataset, original Scope 3 method, CC BY 4.0. No Boavizta API/factors used. Original spreadsheet hardware assumptions remain estimates.

methodology.unit: tCO2e per VM reservation over the full modeled host lifetime; not an hourly footprint.
methodology.scope: Read-only simulation. Current means working catalog after hardware corrections, including pending embodied gap fills. No production dataset or public schema is changed.
methodology.cpuAllocation: Multiply total host impact by reserved VM vCPUs / modeled host vCPUs. No CPU workload utilization factor.
methodology.componentAllocation: Base (including its first 16 GB RAM), additional sockets and local drives use CPU share; extra RAM uses RAM share; GPU plus VRAM uses GPU share. This allocation is a local proposal, not a Teads-certified rule.
methodology.allocationOnly: Apply CPU share, or the modeled weighted component share, to the current stored value. This isolates allocation numerically but does not validate that the old value described the same host.
methodology.recalculated: Reconstruct the host using the earlier Teads audit and its local GPU extension, then allocate it.
methodology.capacity: Use the same selected host reference. No socket-to-thread guessing or silent capping of impossible ratios. Unknown denominators remain excluded; largest-size proxies are marked as assumptions.
methodology.conservation: Component shares conserve each component if total tenant allocations do not exceed host resources. Idle/reserved capacity is not reassigned. Dedicated-host homogeneous packing limits may prevent full capacity allocation.
methodology.occupancy: 75% and 50% sensitivities are hypothetical allocated-capacity ratios, not observed utilization. Dividing by them assumes idle capacity is redistributed to tenants; do not apply to whole-host reservations.
methodology.statistics: Unweighted medians across SKU records, not customer usage, total emissions or a provider market-weighted footprint. No sums across interchangeable catalog SKUs.
methodology.warnings: Official capacity does not verify every host component or actual placement. Profile warnings and source assumptions remain visible. Historical serverless, Apple and non-GPU accelerators need separate treatment.
methodology.migration: Changing embodied from host impact to VM-allocated impact is a semantic breaking change, not an ordinary data refresh. Preserve an explicit host value and allocation metadata or introduce a distinct VM-impact field before publication.

azurePackingIllustrations.assumption: Alternative: maximum homogeneous packing on Dsv6-Type1 and all residual host capacity redistributed equally. Not actual shared-fleet occupancy.
